*
greensfunc_generator_t
)(const diverge_model_t* model, complex128_t Lambda, gf_complex_t* buf)

same as the hamiltonian_generator_t, but the buf needs to be double the size to accomodate both greens functions (for Lambda and conj(Lambda)), i.e., buf of count (2, prod(nk*nkf), n_spin,n_orb, n_spin,n_orb)

diverge_model_t
struct
diverge_model_t

all arrays/structures are autogenerated if they point to NULL the corresponding lengths are then set by the code

Variables
name
char name[MAX_NAME_LENGTH]

optionally, you can name your model (also useful to, e.g., uniquely identify a model).

nk[3]
index_t nk[3]

number of k points in each direction. set to 0 to skip dimension.  required.

nkf[3]
index_t nkf[3]

number of refined k points (total k points in each direction nk[i]*nkf[i]). dimension must match nk[3]. required.

patching
mom_patching_t* patching

structure that holds the Fermi surface patching. Usually allocated with the help of other routines (e.g. diverge_patching_from_indices), but in principle the user's responsibility. Free'd by diverge_model_free if set.

n_ibz_path
index_t n_ibz_path

The band structure routine uses the hopping parameters to generate a band structure along the path.

ibz_path[MAX_N_ORBS][3]
double ibz_path[MAX_N_ORBS][3]

path in crystal (relative to reciprocal lattice vectors) coordinates, relevant for output with diverge_model_to_file. If diverge_model_output_conf_t contains npath=-1 (used via diverge_model_to_file_finegrained), or diverge_model_output_set_npath has been used to set npath=-1, only values within the first primitive zone (PZ) are allowed, i.e., floating point numbers in the range [0,1).  It is possible to skip segments by setting the first element of an element of the ibz_path to the magic value returned from diverge_model_ibz_path_skip_segment (nan with payload). Then, both the segment before and after the special value are skipped.

n_orb
index_t n_orb

number of orbitals & sites. required

lattice
double lattice[3][3]

lattice vectors, given in cartesian coordinates. lattice[i][0,1,2] is the ith lattice vector (C ordering). required.

positions
double positions[MAX_N_ORBS][3]

given in cartesian coordinates (not in crystal/relative coordinates!).  required.

n_sym
index_t n_sym

symmetry setup. use helper functions to generate meaningful symmetry operations (see Symmetries). if n_sym is negative, the Hamiltonian will be resymmetrized before diagonalization.

orb_symmetries
complex128_t* orb_symmetries

orbital/site/spin space symmetry matrices in C ordering. Must be user-allocated. Free'd by diverge_model_free.  shape: (n_sym, n_spin*n_orb, n_spin*n_orb)

rs_symmetries
double rs_symmetries[MAX_N_SYM][3][3]

real space symmetry matrices in C ordering.  shape: (n_sym, 3, 3)

n_hop
index_t n_hop

number of hopping parameters. required.

hop
rs_hopping_t* hop

hopping parameters. user-allocated, free'd by diverge_model_free. Must not be NULL (i.e. uninitialized). required.

hfill
hamiltonian_generator_t hfill

hamiltonian_generator_t that can be used to overwrite the default Hamiltonian generation.

SU2
int SU2

determines which flow equations are used. If SU2 > 0, use SU(2) symmetric flow equations. If SU2 == 0, use non-SU(2) flow equations and enforce exchange symmetric vertices. If SU2 < 0, use nonSU2 flow equations and do not enforce exchange symmetric vertices. required.

n_spin
index_t n_spin

must be set to 1 for SU(2) symmetric models (i.e. if SU2 > 0).  required.

n_vert
index_t n_vert

number of real space vertex elements. required.

vert
rs_vertex_t* vert

real space vertex elements. user-allocated, free'd by diverge_model_free. required.

tu_ff
tu_formfactor_t* tu_ff

formfactor array. If allocated (!=NULL), do not auto-generate formfactors.

n_tu_ff
index_t n_tu_ff

number of formfactors.

n_vert_chan[3]
index_t n_vert_chan[3]

either leave this set by the code, or sort the vertices in channels 'CDP' and give the lengths of these chunks.

vfill
channel_vertex_generator_t vfill

channel_vertex_generator_t for custom channel vertex generation.

ffill
full_vertex_generator_t ffill

full_vertex_generator_t for full vertex generation.

gfill
greensfunc_generator_t gfill

greensfunc_generator_t for custom Green's function generation.

grpoj

greensfunc_generator_t used for projected loops, i.e. Lproj = G×G – Gproj×Gproj (cFRG).

data
char* data

used to add additional information to the struct, useful to "hack" or pass user data to function calls like greensfunc_generator_t.

nbytes_data
index_t nbytes_data

specify how much data is actually added to the struct.

data_destructor

set a nontrivial destructor for the optional data attached to the struct.  ignored if left untouched (NULL)

A slightly modified hamiltonian_generator_t that works in exactly the same way as diverge_hamilton_generator_default except for the fact that it adds the generated elements to 'buf' instead of overwriting them. Useful for custom Hamiltonian generation.

diverge_model_ibz_path_skip_segment
double diverge_model_ibz_path_skip_segment(
void
)

return special NaN that allows to skip segments in the IBZ path. Usage as follows:

m->ibz_path[0][0] = 0.5;
m->ibz_path[1][0] = 0.0;
m->ibz_path[2][0] = diverge_model_ibz_path_skip_segment();
m->ibz_path[3][0] = 0.5;
m->ibz_path[4][0] = 0.0;
m->n_ibz_path = 5;
